title: Estimating the false discovery rate of variable selection

split.decision: Offline materialized original 4 designs x 120 observations x 10 original lambda values, n=1500 p=500 d1=30; val source seeds 1..120, held-out test independent private seeds; opaque random IDs. No full fitting during conversion.

baseline.paper_ref: Figure 5 / Section 5.1. Prior reproduction MAD 0.019008, 120 replicates/design, 2467.2s on 12 cores; not a new benchmark reference.

allowed_changes: FDR estimation theory/algorithm, auxiliary nuisance models, surrogate losses, homotopy integration, bootstrap/variance methods and numerical optimization may change.
The method need not execute the original hFDR estimator or optional bootstrap diagnostic.
When retaining the supplied hFDR estimator, changing only the p-value cutoff threshold=0.1 does not count as a method improvement.
fixed_contract: Estimate the false discovery rate of the specified Lasso selector in the fixed-X Gaussian linear experiment, minimizing guarded bias MAD.

The selected-variable rule is the frozen original Lasso at the supplied lambda grid, including its scaling and selection convention; the target is its FDR, not another selector or per-realization oracle FDP.
Fixed X/y, four designs, 120 replications/design, 40-cell MAD, paired MC bias guard and baseline-SD guard remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not switch the evaluated Lasso to ridge, elastic-net, a different lambda or another feature-selection rule; change null definitions or estimate a different error rate.
No true coefficient labels, modified design matrices, cross-replicate truth pooling or altered scoring.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.
Do not fit correction tables or other constants to extra simulations, including ones drawn from `bench/generator.R`.

Frozen source selector/data functions prevent candidate substitution of an easier selection problem.
